description: Definition of tools and environment capabilities required for Little Dragon Girl on Zeabur.

tools.name: git_safe_push
tools.description: Safely pushes changes to My-Moltbot research folder only.
tools.command: git add research/ && git commit -m 'Update' && git push

tools.name: fetch_repo_content
tools.description: Fetches content from other repos via API or temp clone.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Writes a markdown report to the research directory.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Uses Tavily or SerpApi to search the live internet.

tools.name: query_places
tools.description: Uses Google Places API to find restaurants, addresses, and reviews.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Sends files or summaries via Gmail SMTP.
